comment: Profile behaviour for the infotainment/body-and-chassis half of the car. U1 is not AEC-Q qualified and is NRND -- both only matter (or only reach this severity) under an automotive profile. REACH is required there, and no column carries it. Paired with automotive-safety.expected.json over the SAME BOM: the two must disagree about bom.missing_aecq and agree about everything else, which is what makes the split visible.
